name: Narukami Chizuru
source:
A second-year student who is a member of the string orchestra club, and in charge of the 2nd violin. [url=/c87564]Souta's[/url] younger sister and the daughter of the president of a famous company. Chizuru is hotblooded and takes everything seriously. Due to her hardworking nature, she is always at the top when it comes to her studies.

Chizuru is not only [url=/c32637]Nao's[/url] childhood friend, but she also regards her as one of her best friends and rival. Though she keeps a poker face on at most times, Chizuru has a soft spot for both Nao and [url=/c34092]Riria[/url] - though she tends to scold the latter sometimes.
